name: Survives Impossible Odds
description: You've been subjected to numerous dangerous experiments and somehow lived to tell the tale.
connectionOptions: One PC was involved in an experiment you survived.
You saved one PC during a containment breach.
One PC is fascinated by your accounts of anomalous experiences.
You have unexplained resistance to an anomaly affecting one PC.

abilities.name: Anomaly Exposure
abilities.description: You're trained in resisting the effects of anomalous objects, entities, or phenomena.

abilities.name: Lucky Break
abilities.description: Once per day, you can reroll a defense roll against an anomalous effect.

abilities.name: Adaptive Physiology
abilities.description: Your body has become adaptable to strange conditions. You have +2 to Might defense rolls.

abilities.name: Anomalous Intuition
abilities.description: You can sense general danger from anomalous sources within short range.

abilities.name: Miraculous Recovery
abilities.description: Once per day, when you would be reduced to 0 Might, instead recover 1d6 Might points.

abilities.name: Reality Anchor
abilities.description: Your presence stabilizes reality slightly. Allies within immediate range have an asset on rolls to resist reality-altering effects.

abilities.name: Anomalous Adaptation
abilities.description: Once per day, you can temporarily gain immunity to a specific anomalous effect you've survived before.
